zh.title: 漢莎航空預計12月投入首架A350-1000營運 引進新客艙
zh.summary: 漢莎航空A350-1000將於12月開航；引進新客艙並服務三個亞洲目的地。
body: 德國漢莎航空（Lufthansa）規劃於12月正式開航首條由空中巴士A350-1000廣體客機執飛的航線。
這項營運部署將引進漢莎航空全新的Allegris客艙產品，並為三個亞洲目的地提供額外的高階客艙運能。
根據本站歷史檔案紀錄，漢莎航空先前已選定日本首都東京，作為旗下首架空中巴士A350-1000客機進行商業首航的開航目的地。

en.title: Lufthansa to Launch First Airbus A350-1000 Route in December With New Cabins
en.summary: Lufthansa will launch its first Airbus A350-1000 route in December, introducing Allegris cabins to three Asian destinations.
body: German airline Lufthansa is set to launch its first Airbus A350-1000 route in December, marking the debut of the aircraft type in its commercial fleet.
This route deployment will introduce the carrier's new Allegris cabins while bringing additional premium capacity to three Asian destinations.

According to verified historical records, Lufthansa previously selected Japan's capital city Tokyo as the launch destination for the maiden commercial flight of its first Airbus A350-1000 widebody aircraft.
